$comment: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_CONCURRENT_SUBAGENTS raises the Agent-tool concurrency limit
from its default of 20. /sra-research dispatches roughly 23 answerers in a
round (spec 14.1), so at the default the last wave spills into a second pass
for no reason but the cap.
This does NOT affect Workflow scripts. A workflow's agent() calls are capped
separately at min(16, max(2, cpu_cores - 2)) — 6 on an 8-core machine — and
that limit is computed from the core count at module load with no env var to
override it. workflows/write_wave.js is written with that ceiling in mind.
